name: BSP_SceneProperty_AssignValueFrom
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis. __thiscall(SceneProperty* /*ECX*/, SceneProperty* other), RET 4. Switches on the DESTINATION's type code at +4 and is the authoritative value-storage map for the twelve types: 0, 1 and 4 copy the dword at +0Ch; 2 frees and re-duplicates the string at +0Ch; 3 copies the byte at +0Ch; 5 copies the reference payload through 008F0340(other+18h); 7 copies +0Ch, +10h and +14h as the three V3 floats; 8, 9, 10 and 0Bh share one arm that copies the array block through 008F03B0(other+20h). Code 6 has no arm: a sub-bag is merged by the 008F54F0 recursion instead. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_ScenePropertyBag_Find
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis. __thiscall(ScenePropertyBag* /*ECX*/, const char* key), RET 4. Splits the key at the first '.' (_strchr at 008F228A); with no dot it builds a native string and calls the map find 0043B8B0 on this+4, returning *(node+8) (the 38h property record) or 0. With a dot it copies the head into the shared global buffer 00F89658 (so the routine is not reentrant), looks that up, and recurses on the tail at 008F232B with ECX = record+0Ch only when *(record+4) == 6, which is what makes type 6 the nested sub-bag. An absent property is reported as EAX = 0 with no out-of-band error and no default. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_SceneProperty_SetValueFromToken
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis. __thiscall(SceneProperty* /*ECX*/, const char* token), RET 4. Branches on the type code at +4: type 2 (S) frees the old +0Ch at 008F3381 and stores a 00438E40 duplicate of the token; every other type loads the declaration pointer from record+28h into ECX at 008F33A6 and stores 0048E840(declaration, token), the declaration's name-to-value map find, as an integer at +0Ch. The parser reaches it for S at 008F5D04 and for the type-4 letters E and LUA_S at 008F5E6F. The decompiler's early return after the _free is an artifact: 008F3381 falls through to 008F3394. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_ScenePropertyBag_Insert
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis. __thiscall(ScenePropertyBag* /*ECX*/, const char* key, SceneProperty* record), RET 8, returns the bag. Inserts through 008F28F0, then stamps record+30h with the owning bag and, only when record+34h is still 0, takes the bag's counter at +10Ch into record+34h and writes the counter back incremented. The counter starts at 0 and 0 is also the unstamped sentinel, so the first record inserted into a bag is re-stamped if it is ever inserted again. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_ScenePropertyBag_SetString
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis. __thiscall(ScenePropertyBag* /*ECX*/, const char* key, const char* value), RET 8. operator_new(0x38) at 008F38BD, then vtable 00CE89D4 at +0, type code 2 (S) at +4, 00438E40-duplicated value at +0Ch, zeroes at +18h/+1Ch/+20h/+24h/+30h/+34h, byte 1 at +2Ch, and 008F33F0 insert under the key. It leaves +08h, +10h, +14h and +28h uninitialised; +28h is the enum declaration, read only under type 4, so a record built here and later retyped would read heap garbage. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_ScenePropertyBag_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis. __thiscall(ScenePropertyBag* /*ECX*/, void* owner), RET 4. Writes the 114h bag: vtable 00D16504 at +0, the embedded hash map's vtable 00D162C4 at +4, entry count 0 at +8, 64 zeroed bucket heads at +0Ch..+10Bh (MOV ECX,0x40 / STOSD.REP), the insertion-ordinal counter 0 at +10Ch and the owner argument at +110h. The map's this is bag+4, so its bucket array (map+8) is bag+0Ch; 4 + 108h + 8 = 114h. 008F41FC and 008F66DB are two inlined copies of this body that store 0 as the owner. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_ScenePropertyBag_Clone
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis. __thiscall(ScenePropertyBag* /*ECX*/), plain RET: no stack arguments. operator_new(0x114) plus an inlined copy of the 008F41A0 constructor with owner 0, then a walk of this+4 with the 00480690 / 0047E480 iterator: per node it takes the key at node+4 (or 00F89450 when null), clones the record at node+8 with 008F4F60 and inserts the clone under that key with 008F33F0. Returns the new bag. It is a deep copy, not a reader: 0046C623 hands the clone to 004693C0 as the first of six stack arguments (RET 18h) and 0046DB5A clones before 008F54F0 merges into the copy. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_SceneProperty_Clone
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis, PARTIAL: six of the twelve switch arms (types 0 to 5) were read. __thiscall(SceneProperty* /*ECX*/), plain RET, returns a new record. Every arm read allocates operator_new(0x38) and copies the source's +34h ordinal onto the clone, which is what fixes the record size at 38h for all twelve types; the type-4 arm passes record+28h and record+0Ch to its constructor, confirming +28h as the enum declaration. Callers: 008F41F0 clone and 008F561D merge. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_ScenePropertyBag_MergeFrom
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis. __thiscall(ScenePropertyBag* dest /*ECX*/, ScenePropertyBag* source, char keepExisting). Registers resolved by filtering the listing: 008F550C spills ECX to the local the lookup at 008F5588 and the insert at 008F5636 reload, and the iterator at 008F5520 walks [ESP+0x28]+4, the first stack argument, so ECX is the destination and argument 1 the source; argument 2 is the byte at [ESP+0x34] after the EBP/EDI pushes. Per source entry: a key absent from dest is cloned with 008F4F60, has its +34h ordinal copied at 008F562E and is inserted with 008F33F0; a key present as a type-6 record recurses at 008F55F6 on both sides' +0Ch; a key present otherwise is overwritten through 008F0700 only when keepExisting is 0. 008F5AB3 merges a group-list bag with 0, so a group overwrites; 0046DB66 merges with 1, so the destination clone's own values win. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_ScenePropertyBag_Parse
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_scene_records, read-only analysis; already described as the property-bag parser by docs/SCENE_FILE_READER.md. __fastcall(Tokenizer* /*ECX*/, char allowUntypedValues, int parseGroupList). Optional '( name name ... )' group list, then '{'; the body loop reads a key, looks it up with 008f2260, and if the next token is '=' consumes it and runs the per-type read for the letter, otherwise recurses into a sub-bag only when the next token is '{' and silently drops the key when it is neither (008f6xxx else branch). Every typed read ends with BSP_SceneTokenizer_ExpectToken 008d9930 for the ';', which peeks and consumes only on a match, so a property authored without its terminator costs one reported error and consumes nothing further. That bounded read is what the reconstruction's value scan had to be corrected to; see docs/SCENE_FILE_READER.md Corrections. | CORRECTION, packet cc2_scene_property_bag: the ABI above is wrong. RET 0Ch is three stack arguments and ECX is the BAG, not the tokenizer: 008F5A25 copies ECX into EBX and spills it to [ESP+18h], from where it is reloaded as the this of every 008F3xxx setter (008F5D17, 008F6724) and of the recursive call at 008F6740, while 008F5A1E loads the tokenizer from the first stack argument into ESI for every 008D8xxx/008D9xxx call. So __thiscall(ScenePropertyBag* /*ECX*/, Tokenizer*, char allowUntypedNumbers, void* groupRegistry). Argument 3 is not a boolean: 008F5A47 loads it into EDI and 008F5AA9 calls 00469B60 on it to turn each name of the leading '( name name ... )' list into a bag, which 008F5AB3 then merges with keepExisting = 0, so that list is inheritance and a group's values overwrite. Argument 2 is the byte at [ESP+154h] that forces the I and F readers to read even when 008D8F10/008D8F40 say the next token is not a number. The twelve type codes, their letters, the eight reference sub-kinds and the 114h bag layout are in docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.

name: BSP_Startup_ResolveLanguage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. thiscall, ECX is an out native string (008f8322 LEA ECX,[ESP+0xc]); returns this in EAX; RET 0. Seeds the string with 'english' (0041e870), builds <CSIDL_PERSONAL>\Battlestations-Pacific\options.txt via SHGetSpecialFolderPathA(5,fCreate=1) and the concat at 004261a0, and fopen(...,'rt'). On success the file is read into a memory backing and tokenised; a token matching 'Language' (00d15f1c, compare 00438e10) makes the next token the value (008f8070..008f808b). On fopen failure only, HKLM\SOFTWARE\Eidos\Battlestations Pacific value 'language' is read and, if REG_DWORD, mapped 0x407 german / 0x40a spanish / 0x40c french / 0x410 italian / default english (switch 008f7f9c). docs/WINMAIN_STARTUP.md

name: BSP_WinMain
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. stdcall(HINSTANCE, HINSTANCE, LPSTR, int) from the CRT at 00bfd0dd; both exits are XOR EAX,EAX / RET 10h, so the process exit code is always 0 and none of the four arguments is ever read (no frame access above the return address). Sequence: CoInitializeEx(0, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED) then CoInitializeSecurity(NULL,-1,NULL,NULL,RPC_C_AUTHN_LEVEL_NONE,RPC_C_IMP_LEVEL_IMPERSONATE,NULL,0,NULL); on success CoCreateInstance(CLSID_GameExplorer 9a5ea990-3034-4d6f-9128-01f3c61022bc, CLSCTX_ALL, IID_IGameExplorer e7b2fb72-d728-49b3-a5f2-18eb f5f1349e); GetCurrentDirectoryA(0xbfe) plus '\battlestationspacific.exe' is widened by 004c5e60 and passed to IGameExplorer::VerifyAccess (vtable +18h); a FALSE result calls CRT exit(0) at 008f82ee before Release and CoUninitialize. Both COM-init failure branches still reach CoUninitialize. Then BSP_RandomThreads_Initialize, a one byte slot allocation gating BSP_RandomThreads_RegisterCurrent, and CreateMutexA(NULL, TRUE, 'MidwayThreadMutex'). A non-null handle with GetLastError()==ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS takes the already-running path: BSP_Startup_ResolveLanguage, a localized MessageBoxW (MB_ICONHAND) chosen by 00425850 comparisons, free of the language buffer, return 0 without closing the mutex or shutting the random subsystem down. Otherwise SetThreadAffinityMask(GetCurrentThread(),1), BSP_GameResourceFactory_GetSingleton stored to 00f8d31c, then on one 0x1c byte stack object BSP_Application_Construct, BSP_Application_Initialize(0,'cachedload'), BSP_Platform_RunLoopDispatch, BSP_Application_Shutdown, BSP_Application_Destruct; teardown destroys and frees the singleton manager at 01090aa0 and clears it, CloseHandle, unregister and free the thread slot, BSP_RandomThreads_Shutdown unconditionally. The Ghidra pseudocode aliases the COM out pointer with the language string object and wrongly returns inside the 01090aa0 branch. docs/WINMAIN_STARTUP.md | Packet orch3_startup_language_l: bounded008F832B..008F83BE message selector now accepts the actual8-byte native header and uses canonical00425850 for the same five fixed nonnull literals in original AL-test order. Header identity from008F8322/008F7DD6 is preserved by the new API; native release reloads current header only after MessageBoxW. Existing std::string runtime has no actual resolver owner and retains explicitly documented C-string projection. Same message selection on this subset; no startup bug or full00425850 trace equivalence claimed. Misleading private helper removed. Strict Win32/2CTests/8seed checks and8case ignored source fixture passed; 148fragment bytes match live Ghidra and disk. docs/STARTUP_LANGUAGE_BINDING.md; reports/startup_language_binding.json. No full WinMain/SEH/allocator or game closure. | Correction from docs/STARTUP_COM_BINDING.md: 008F81F8 PUSH8 means COINIT_MULTITHREADED|COINIT_SPEED_OVER_MEMORY, not apartment-threaded; security auth level0 is DEFAULT, not NONE(1). Actual SDK Game Explorer CoCreateInstance/VerifyAccess/Release now bound in src/game_hosts.cpp. Native independent pointer release guard after negative HRESULT, uninitialized output BOOL and ignored VerifyAccess HRESULT preserved. BFBDBB(code) calls BFBCD9(code,0,0), reverse on-exit table/full cleanup, so host uses genuine std::exit. Actual MTA, COM security, Game Explorer access query and atexit callback checked in isolated processes. This closes bounded process bindings, not original ABI, pooled wide-string ownership, whole WinMain or gameplay. Descriptive name remains a hypothesis.
